players.inj: Day-To-Day — Doncic has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit due to lower-back tightness, Trevor Lane of LakersNation.com reports.

Out — Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.
Out — Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

Out — Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.
Day-To-Day — Jokic (elbow) is listed as questionable for Monday's game in Houston.
Day-To-Day — Barnes (adductor) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Day-To-Day — DeRozan is questionable for Monday's game against the Rockets due to lower back spasms.
Out — Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Out — Powell (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Out — Markkanen (wrist) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
Day-To-Day — Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.
Day-To-Day — Davis (ankle) is listed as questionable for Monday's game in Detroit.
Day-To-Day — Quickley (hamstring) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Out — Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
Day-To-Day — Murray is questionable for Monday's game against the Rockets due to a left shin contusion.
Day-To-Day — Allen (knee) is questionable for Monday's game against Charlotte.
Out — Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Out — Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Out — Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
Out — Sabonis (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Heat.
Out — Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Day-To-Day — Diabate (quadriceps) is questionable for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.
Out — Miller (groin) is listed as out for Monday's game against Cleveland.
Out — Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
Day-To-Day — Bane (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors.
Day-To-Day — George will not return to Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right ankle injury.
